summary: Very steep residential street with houses 7-9 m from the kerb.
reasons: Dwellings 7-9 m away on this side

best_section.where: Bottom of Manchester Terrace at the corner, west kerb

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb along its length; nearest dwellings 7-9 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, a few cars parked on both sides; usable but the gradient is extreme.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street, but dense housing makes a van conspicuous.

sun_shade: Mostly open sealed street; trees shade the west side at the bottom.
